pages.text: Perks are special passive bonuses that you unlock using perk points. You earn perk points at level milestones:$(br)$(li)Level 20: +1 point$  $(li)Level 40: +1 point$  $(li)Level 50: +1 point$  $(li)Level 60: +1 point$  $(li)Level 80: +1 point$  $(li)Level 100: +3 points

Perks are organized into talent trees across all 5 categories. Each perk has a stat level requirement. Open the Perks screen (default key: N) to spend your perk points.$(br2)Some notable perks:$(li)Will Focus - Reduces negative effect duration by 15%$(li)Iron Skin - +2 armor per 10 levels
